title: helodium
intro: Helodium, commonly known as Helodium tuberculatum, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to tropical regions and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Helodium include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Helodium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial effects.
